title: 13 — Stat Surround / Callout Radial (Product Hero)
description: Product centered in a clean gradient frame. Four stat callouts (big number + small label) float in the corners, each connected to the product with a hand-drawn curved arrow. A price badge near the product. Scattered "appetite appeal" props (food crumbs, ingredient bits) at the base. Works for info-dense products (food, supplements, personal care) where multiple stats compete for attention.
